description: This file defines API routes for task management in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, completing, reopening, and deleting tasks, utilizing SQLAlchemy for database interactions and Pydantic schemas for request/response models.

methods.name: _apply_status_filter(stmt, status_filter: TaskStatusFilter)
methods.description: Applies a filter to the SQL statement based on task completion status.

methods.name: _apply_text_search(stmt, q: Optional[str])
methods.description: Filters tasks based on a case-insensitive search in title or description.

methods.name: _apply_sort(stmt, sort_by: TaskSortBy, order: SortOrder)
methods.description: Applies sorting to the task query based on specified field and order.

methods.name: list_tasks( db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), status_filter: TaskStatusFilter = Query("all", alias="status", description="Filter by completion status"), category_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by category id"), q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Text search across title/description"), due_from: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter due_date >= due_from"), due_to: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter due_date <= due_to"), sort_by: TaskSortBy = Query("created_at", description="Field to sort by"), order: SortOrder = Query("desc", description="Sort order"), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200, description="Page size"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Offset"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list tasks with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: get_task(task_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Fetches a specific task by ID.

methods.name: create_task(payload: TaskCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Creates a new task after validating optional category ID.

methods.name: update_task(task_id: int, payload: TaskUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Performs partial updates on an existing task.

methods.name: reopen_task(task_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Reopens a completed task, setting it to active.
